hook.name: FablesRWAETH
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pools that sets LP fees based on US market calendar sessions (open, overnight, closed) with a linear opening descent and closing ramp driven by block.timestamp. Supports operator "poke" overrides with TTL and per-pool fee caps. The ETH variant adds native ETH (currency0) settlement support via WETH wrapping.
